label: Landscape menu board
description: 1920x1080 menu board: header lockup, three-bar rule, four item rows with price lockups and allergen codes, one hero photo panel, legal strip. Readable from frame 0 — the base scene is fully settled at t=0, so the loop seam is exact.

hero.note: Menu-board hero uses the un-matted frame with object-fit cover + focal point. Cutouts are used by the promo template.

beats.why: micro-motion on the photo so the board is not a still image; returns to scale 1, so frame 0 == last frame
a second, slower beat on the other side of the screen; also returns to its start state

rules.noInBeats: The base scene must not use in/out presets: anything hidden at t=0 would break the seamless loop and would make the board unreadable for a customer who walks up mid-loop.
